purpose: MiniMax Music 3 32 kHz -> controlled lowpass -> FlashSR 48 kHz

phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.name: bypass_parity
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.expect: output is bit-identical to the input - no gain, no delay, no dither

phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.name: eq_single_bell
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.expect: measured response matches the node's reported response_db within +/-0.5 dB; the incoming tensor is not modified

phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.name: auto_eq_proposal
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.expect: nothing is audible until the proposal is applied by hand; the report keeps applied=false

phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.name: mastering_loudness
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.expect: integrated LUFS within +/-0.3 LUFS of the target and true peak at or below the ceiling, both checked against an independent measurement - never only against the node's own report

phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.name: long_track_blocks
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.chain: mastering on a track longer than five minutes
phase_3_eq_mastering_tests.expect: block parity - one pass and chunked passes agree; silence, a 0.1 s signal and an extreme allowed setting produce no NaN/Inf

phase_4_v01_report_checks.name: effective_vs_recommended
phase_4_v01_report_checks.expect: runtime.resource_profile keeps recommended and effective as separate keys; effective names the device and model that actually ran

phase_4_v01_report_checks.name: additive_sections
phase_4_v01_report_checks.expect: mastering.eq / mastering.auto_eq / mastering.chain carry the DSP nodes' own report schemas; unwired inputs add no key at all

phase_4_v01_report_checks.name: reproducibility
phase_4_v01_report_checks.expect: models and llm.template_version identify the run; repeating it with the same seeds reproduces the same result

phase_4_v01_report_checks.name: public_example
phase_4_v01_report_checks.expect: a payload passed through production_metadata.public_safe_payload() contains no secret-named key and no absolute path
